task_evaluations.name: S3 Access Patterns
task_evaluations.description: Tests S3 data access patterns from Python
task_evaluations.prompt: What are the best practices for reading and writing data to S3 from Python?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain S3 access patterns using fsspec, s3fs, and other libraries, including authentication and performance considerations.

task_evaluations.name: Cloud Library Selection
task_evaluations.description: Tests ability to select cloud access libraries
task_evaluations.prompt: Should I use fsspec, PyArrow filesystem, or obstore for accessing cloud storage?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should compare cloud storage access libraries and recommend based on use case, performance needs, and ecosystem.

task_evaluations.name: GCS and Azure Access
task_evaluations.prompt: How do I access GCS and Azure Blob Storage from Python data tools?
task_evaluations.expected_behavior: The skill should explain GCS and Azure access patterns using gcsfs, adlfs, and other libraries.
